description: This Java class defines a custom ViewGroup called FoldingLayout that creates a folding animation effect on its single child view. It manages fold parameters such as number of folds, orientation, and anchor point, and performs complex matrix transformations and drawing routines to simulate folding with shadows and perspective.

classes.name: FoldingLayout
classes.description: A custom ViewGroup that applies a folding animation effect to its single child view, allowing configuration of fold parameters and rendering the folding with perspective and shadows.

classes.name: Orientation
classes.description: Enum defining fold orientation: VERTICAL or HORIZONTAL.

classes.name: NumberOfFoldingLayoutChildrenException
classes.description: RuntimeException thrown when more than one child view is added to FoldingLayout.

methods.name: addViewInLayout
methods.description: Overrides to prevent adding more than one child view.

methods.name: addView
methods.description: Overrides to prevent adding more than one child view.

methods.name: onMeasure
methods.description: Measures the single child view and sets the layout's dimensions.

methods.name: onLayout
methods.description: Positions the child view and updates the fold.

methods.name: throwCustomException
methods.description: Throws exception if more than one child view is added.

methods.name: setFoldListener
methods.description: Sets a listener for fold start/end events.

methods.name: setFoldFactor
methods.description: Sets the fold factor (0 to 1) and recalculates matrices.

methods.name: setOrientation
methods.description: Sets fold orientation and updates fold.

methods.name: setAnchorFactor
methods.description: Sets the anchor point factor and updates fold.

methods.name: setNumberOfFolds
methods.description: Sets the number of folds and updates fold.

methods.name: updateFold
methods.description: Prepares and recalculates matrices for current fold parameters.

methods.name: prepareFold
methods.description: Initializes fold parameters, segments the view into folds, and prepares transformation matrices.

methods.name: calculateMatrices
methods.description: Computes transformation matrices for each fold segment based on current fold factor.

methods.name: dispatchDraw
methods.description: Draws the folded view segments with transformations and shadows.
